Name: Wurmple Companion
Author: Dragonlover736
Description:
A Wurmple companion that will follow you around in game. Includes a normal and shiny version. Purchase them from the hat shop and equip them as rings, and tah-da! You now have a new Wurmple companion. Don't worry if he gets stuck, he'll always teleport to you!

[b][u]Both versions should now be compatible with each other!!!
[/u][/b]Originally, both Wurmples would appear as shiny when both mods were installed. For some reason the normal Wurmple ignores it's own png and opts to use the one for shiny wurmple instead. [b]This should now be fixed if you download and use the CC Shiny Wurmple - New Compatibility update files instead of the old Shiny Wurmple files. 

Both updated shiny and normal Wurmples work on the steam deck too.[/b]

Made for myself, but feel free to use and enjoy!

Unlikely to continue to update.
